senses.gloss:
कुल् कुल्, cl. 1. P. कोलति, चुकोल, &c.,
कोलितुम्, to accumulate, collect; to be of
kin, to behave as a kinsman; to proceed continuously
or without interruption; to count.

कूल् 2. कूल् or कूड्, cl. 10. P., Ved. कूल-
यति, -यितुम्, to burn, scorch.

कुल कुल, अम्, n. (fr. rt. कुल्?), a herd, a
troop, a flock, an assemblage, a multitude, a number
&c. (of quadrupeds, birds, insects, &c., or of inanimate
objects, e. g. गो-कुल, a herd of cows; मृग-कुल,
a herd of deer; महिषी-कुल, a herd of female
buffaloes; अलि-कुल, a swarm of bees; अलक-कुल,
a multitude of curls); a race, family, community,
tribe, caste, association, set, company (e. g. ब्राह्-
मण-कुल, the caste of the Brāhmans); the resi-
dence of a family, seat of a community; (in a
contemptuous sense) a lot, a gang (forming a comp.
with a preceding gen. sing., e. g. चौरस्य-कुल,
a gang of thieves); an inhabited country; a house,
an abode; a noble or eminent family or race; high
station (often at the beginning of a compound =
chief, principal; see कुल-गिरि below); the body; the
front, fore part; a blue stone; (अस्), m. the chief of
a corporation or guild; [cf. Hib. gaol, ‘a family or
kindred.’] कुलि and कुली, see s. v.
—कुल-कज्जल,
अस्, m. disgrace of the family.
—कुल-कण्टक, अस्,
m. ‘a family-thorn,’ any one who is a trouble to his
family.
—कुल-कन्या, f. a girl of good family.
—कुल-कर, अस्, ई, अम्, founding a family, the
founder of a family or race, an ancestor.
—कुल-
कर्कटी, f. a kind of gourd; [cf. चीनाकर्कती.]
—कुल-कर्तृ, ता, m. the founder of a family or
race, an ancestor.
—कुल-कर्मन्, अ, n. the peculiar
or proper duty of a family or race, any observance or
custom peculiar to a family.
—कुल-कलङ्क, अस्, m.
‘a family-stain,’ any one who disgraces his family.
—कुल-क्षय, अस्, m. decay or downfall of a race
or family; (आ), f. a sort of cowach, Mucuna Pruritus
(= शूकशिम्बी).
—कुल-गरिमन्, आ, m. family
pride.
—कुल-गिरि, इस्, m. a chief mountain, any one
of the seven principal mountains of Bhārata-varṣa;
see कुलाचल.
—कुल-गृह, अम्, n. a noble house.
—कुल-गोप, अस्, m., Ved. the protector of a
domicile.
—कुल-गौरव, अम्, n. family import-
ance.
—कुल-घ्न, अस्, आ or ई, अम्, destroying a
family.
—कुल-चन्द्र, अस्, m., N. of a scholiast
on the Kātantra grammar; N. of the author of the
Durgāvākya-prabodha.
—कुल-चूडामणि, title of a
work.
—कुल-च्युत, अस्, आ, अम्, rejected by his
family.
—कुल-ज or कुल-जात, अस्, आ, अम्, born in
a noble family, of a good or noble family, well-born,
of good breed; ancestral, hereditary.
—कुल-जन,
अस्, m. a person belonging to a noble family, a high-
born or distinguished person.
—कुल-तत्त्व-विद्, त्,
त्, त्, knowing the true state of a family.
—कुल-तस्,
ind. by birth.
—कुल-तिथि, इस्, m. f. an important
lunar day, the fourth, eighth, twelfth, or fourteenth
day of the half-month.
—कुल-तिलक, अस्, m. the
glory of a family, one who does honour to a family.
—कुल-दमन, अस्, आ, अम्, subduing a family,
holding it in subjection.
—कुल-दीप or कुल-
दीपक, अस्, m. the lamp or light or glory of a race
or family; (इका), f. title of a work treating on the
noble families of Bengal.
—कुल-दुहितृ, ता, f. the
daughter of a noble family; a high-born maiden.
—कुल-देवता, f. a principal deity; an epithet of
the goddess Durgā.
—कुल-दैव, अम्, n. family
destiny; a principal deity.
—कुल-धर्म, अस्, m.
practice or observance peculiar to a tribe or family,
peculiar duty of caste or race.
—कुल-धारक, अस्,
m. ‘upholder of the family,’ a son.
—कुल-धुर्य,
अस्, m. one who is able to support a family, a grown-
up son.
—कुल-नक्षत्र, अम्, n. any Nakṣatra
or lunar mansion distinguished above others; any
auspicious asterism.
—कुल-नन्दन, अस्, आ, अम्,
causing joy to a family, doing honour to a family; a
[]
high-born virtuous child.
—कुल-नायिका, f. a girl
worshipped at the celebration of the orgies of the left-
hand Śāktas.
—कुल-नारी, f. a woman of good
family; a high-bred virtuous woman.
—कुल-नाश,
अस्, m. a camel; a reprobate, an outcast.
—कुल-
निन्दा, f. family disgrace.
—कुलन्-धर, अस्, आ, अम्,
upholding a family.
—कुल-प, अस्, m., Ved. the
chief of a family or race or tribe.
—कुल-पति, इस्,
m. the head or chief of a family.
—कुल-पत्त्र, अस्,
m. a plant, commonly called Damanaka.
—कुल-
परम्परा, f. the series of generations comprising
a race.
—कुल-पर्वत or कुल-शैल, अस्, m. a
principal mountain, any one of seven mountains in
Bhārata; [cf. कुल-गिरि.]
—कुल-पांसुका, f. an
unchaste woman.
—कुल-पालक, अस्, इका, अम्, pro-
tecting a family, nourishing or providing for a family;
(अम्), n. a kind of orange, = कुरुम्ब, commonly
कमलानेवु.
—कुल-पालि, इस्, f. or कुल-पालिका,
f. or कुल-पाली, f. a chaste, high-born, or noble
woman.
—कुल-पुत्र, अस्, m. a son of a noble
family, a noble or respectable youth; (ई), f. the
daughter of a good family, a high-born or respectable
girl; [cf. कुल-दुहितृ.]
—कुल-पुत्रक, अस्, m.,
N. of a plant, = कुल-पत्त्र and मुनि-पुत्र.
—कुलपुत्र-जन, अस्, m. the son of a good
family, a noble or respectable youth.
—कुल-पु-
रुष, अस्, m. a man of good family, a noble or
respectable man; an ancestor, any family progenitor.
—कुल-पूर्वग, अस्, m. an ancestor.
—कुल-
प्रकाश, अस्, m. title of a work.
—कुल-प्रसूत,
अस्, आ, अम्, born in a noble family.
—कुल-बधू,
ऊस्, f. a noble, virtuous, or respectable woman; [cf. कु-
ल-योषित्.]
—कुल-बालिका, f. = कुल-पालिका above.
—कुल-भार्या, f. a virtuous, noble, or high-bred
wife.
—कुल-भूभृत्, त्, m. a principal mountain,
one of the seven mountains in Bhārata.
—कुल-
भूषण, अस्, आ, अम्, ‘family-adorning,’ a family
ornament.
—कुल-भृत्या, f. the nursing of a preg-
nant woman; a midwife, a nurse?; [cf. कुमार-
भृत्या.]
—कुल-भेद-कर, अस्, m. one who
causes discord in a family.
—कुल-भ्रष्ट, अस्, आ,
अम्, expelled from a family.
—कुल-मर्यादा, f.
family honour or respectability.
—कुल-मार्ग, अस्,
m. the best or principal way, the way of honesty.
—कुल-मित्र, अम्, n. a friend of the family.
—कु-
लम्-पुन, अस्, आ, अम्, purifying a family; (अम्), n.,
N. of a Tīrtha; (आ), f., N. of a river.
—कुलम्-
भर, अस्, आ, अम्, carrying or upholding a family;
(अस्), m. a wrong form for कुजम्भल, a thief.
—कुल-योषित्, त्, f. a woman of noble family; a
virtuous high-born woman.
—कुल-रक्षक, अस्,
आ, अम्, preserving a family.
—कुल-रत्न-मालिका,
f. title of a work.
—कुल-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, be-
longing to a noble family.
—कुल-वधू, ऊस्, f. a
virtuous wife, a respectable woman, one of good
family.
—कुलवधू-ता, f. virtue in a wife.
—कुल-
वर्णा, f. a species of the plant Convolvulus with
red blossoms, = रक्त-त्रिवृत्.
—कुल-वर्धन or
कुल-वर्धक, अस्, आ, अम्, increasing or advancing
or propagating a family.
—कुल-वार, अस्, m. a
principal day, i. e. Tuesday and Friday.
—कुल-
विद्या, f. knowledge handed down in a family.
—कुल-विप्र, अस्, m. a family priest.
—कुल-
वृद्ध, अस्, m. the oldest member or head of a
family.
—कुल-वृद्धि, इस्, f. family advancement.
—कुल-व्यापिन्, ई, इनी, इ, attaching or applicable to
tribe or caste.
—कुल-व्रत, अम्, n. a family vow.
—कुल-शील, अस्, अम्, m. n. character or conduct
honourable to a family.
—कुल-शील-समन्वित, अस्,
आ, अम्, endowed with a noble character or disposi-
tion.
—कुल-शेखर, अस्, m., N. of the author of
Mukunda-mālā.
—कुल-श्रेष्ठिन्, ई, इनी, इ, well-
born; of good family, eminent in a family; (ई), m.
the chief of a guild; an artificer or artisan of eminent
birth.
—कुल-सङ्ख्या, f. ranking or being reckoned
as a family, family respectability.
—कुल-सत्त्र, अम्,
n. a family sacrifice.
—कुल-सन्तति, इस्, f. propa-
gation of a family, posterity, descendants.
—कुल-
सन्निधि, इस्, m. the presence of a number of persons
or of witnesses, kindred, relations.
—कुल-समुद्-
भव, अस्, आ, अम्, born in a noble family.
—कुल-
[]
सम्भव, अस्, आ, अम्, sprung from a noble family;
(in compounds) sprung from a family.
—कुल-सार-
तन्त्र, अम्, n., N. of a Tantra.
—कुल-सुन्दरी,
f., N. of a deity.
—कुल-सेवक, अस्, m. an excellent
attendant or servant.
—कुल-सौरभ, अम्, n., N.
of a plant, = मरुवक.
—कुल-स्त्री, f. a woman of
good family, a respectable woman, a chaste or virtuous
wife.
—कुल-स्थिति, इस्, f. antiquity or prosperity of
a family.
—कुलाकुल (˚ल-अक्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, excel-
lent and not excellent, middling; of mixed character,
of mixed origin; (अस्), m., N. of a Dānava.
—कुला-
कुल-तिथि, इस्, m. f. the second, sixth, and tenth
lunar days of a half-month.
—कुलाकुल-नक्षत्र,
अम्, n., N. of the lunar mansions Ārdrā, Mūlā, Abhi-
jit, and Śatabhiṣā; an asterism of mixed character.
—कुलाकुल-वार, अस्, m. Wednesday.
—कुलाङ्-
गना (˚ल-अङ्˚), f. a woman of good family, a
respectable or chaste woman.
—कुलाङ्गार (˚ल-
अङ्˚), अस्, m. ‘a family firebrand,’ metaphorically a
man who foments domestic dissensions or ruins his
family.
—कुलाचल (˚ल-अच्˚), अस्, m. a principal
mountain, one of a class of seven principal mountains
which are supposed to exist in each Varṣa or division
of a continent; those of Bhārata-varṣa or India are
Mahendra, Malaya, Sahya, Śuktimat, Ṛkṣa, Vin-
dhya, and Pāripātra or Pāriyātra; N. of a Dānava.
—कुलाचार (˚ल-आच्˚), अस्, m. the peculiar or proper
duty of a family or caste.
—कुलाचार्य (˚ल-आच्˚),
अस्, m. a family teacher, a family priest; a person
well versed in the pedigrees and customs of different
families and employed to contract marriages between
them; a genealogist.
—कुलाद्रि (˚ल-अद्˚), इस्, m. a
principal mountain; one of seven principal mountains;
see कुलाचल above.
—कुलाधारक (˚ल-आध्˚), अस्,
m. a son; [cf. कुल-धारक.]
—कुलान्वित (˚ल-
अन्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, sprung from a noble family.
—कुला-
भिमान (˚ल-अभ्˚), अम्, n. pride of birth, family
pride.
—कुलाभिमानिन्, ई, इनी, इ, proud of birth or of
family descent.
—कुलामृत (˚ल-अम्˚), अम्, n. title
of a work.
—कुलार्णव (˚ल-अर्˚), अस्, m. title of a
work.
—कुलार्णव-तन्त्र, अम्, n., N. of a Tantra.
—कुलालम्बिन् (˚ल-आल्˚), ई, इनी, इ, supporting or
maintaining a family.
—कुले-चर, अस् or अम् (?), m.
or n. (?) , a kind of plant.
—कुलेश्वर (˚ल-ईश्˚), अस्,
m. the chief of a family or race; the lord κατ᾽ ἐξοχήν,
an epithet of Śiva; (ई), f. an epithet of Durgā.
—कु-
लोत्कट (˚ल-उत्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, excellent by birth, high-
born; (अस्), m. a horse of good breed.
—कुलोत्-
कर्ष (˚ल-उत्˚), अस्, m. family eminence.
—कुलोत्-
पन्न (˚ल-उत्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, sprung from a good
family, well-born; belonging to a family (as property
&c.).
—कुलोद्गत (˚ल-उद्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, sprung
from a noble family.
—कुलोद्भव, अस्, आ, अम्,
or कुलोद्भूत (˚ल-उद्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, well-born, of
good family; born or produced in a family.
—कुलोद्-
वह (˚ल-उद्˚), अस्, m. a chief, a leader, the head of a
family.
—कुलोपदेश (˚ल-उप्˚), अस्, m. family name.

कुल, अम्, n.; add — (with Śāktas), epithet of
Śakti and of the rites observed in her worship [cf.
कौल].

कूल, अम्, n. a declivity, slope; a shore, a
bank; a heap, a mound; a pond or pool; the rear
of an army; N. of a region; [cf. अज-कूला, अनु-
कूल, उत्कूल, &c.; cf. also Hib. cul, ‘custody,
guard, defence, the back part of anything;’ col, ‘an
impediment;’ Lat. collis?].
—कूलङ्-कष, अस्, आ,
अम्, carrying or tearing away the bank; (अस्), m. the
ocean, the sea; the stream or current of a river; (आ),
f. a river.
—कूल-चर, अस्, ई, अम्, frequenting the
banks of rivers, grazing there &c.
—कूल-भू, ऊस्,
f. a bank, the land upon the bank or shore.
—कू-
लम्-उद्रुज, अस्, आ, अम्, breaking down banks, as a
river &c.
—कूलम्-उद्वह, अस्, आ, अम्, carrying or
tearing away the bank, as a river &c.
—कूल-वत्,
आन्, अती, अत्, furnished with shores; (ती), f. a river.
—कूल-हण्डक, अस्, m. an eddy.

कुलक, अस्, आ, अम्, relating to a tribe or family, of
good family, of eminent birth; (अस्), m. the chief of a
guild; any artisan of eminent birth; an ant-hill, a mole-
hill; a green snake (हरित-सर्प); N. of several
plants, a kind of ebony, Diospyros Tomentosa; another
species of ebony, commonly called Ku-pīlu; another
plant, = मरुवक, शुक्लपुष्प, तिलक; (अम्),
n. a multitude; a sort of gourd, Trichosanthes
Diœca; a number of stanzas in grammatical con-
nection, several verses in which the government of
noun and verb is carried throughout, contrary to the
practice of closing the sense with each verse; a kind
of prose composition with few compound words.

कुलक्क कुलक्क, अस्, m. a cymbal; beating
time in music.
कुलायन, अस्, m., N. of a man.

कुलिक, अस्, आ, अम्, of a good family, well-born;
(अस्), m. a kinsman; the chief or head man of a tribe
or caste; an artist or artificer of high birth; a thorny
plant, Ruellia Longifolia or Asteracantha (Ruellia)
Longifolia; one of the eight chiefs of the Nāgas or
serpent-race, described as having a half-moon on the
top of his head and being of a dusky-brown colour.
—कुलिक-वेला, f. certain portions of each day on
which it is improper to begin any good business.
कुलीका कुलीका, f., Ved. a kind of bird.

कूलिक कूलिक, अस्, m., N. of a prince; (आ),
f. the bottom or lower part of the Indian lute.
कुलिन्, ई, इनी, इ, belonging to a noble family.

कूलिन्, ई, इनी, इ, furnished with banks or shores;
(इनी), f. a river.

कुलीन, अस्, आ, अम् (at the end of compounds),
belonging to a family; of high or eminent descent,
of a good family, well-born; (अस्), m. a horse of
good breed; a Brāhman of the highest class in Ben-
gal, i. e. a member of one of the eight principal
families of the Vārendra division or of one of the
six chief families of the Rāḍha or Rāṛh division as
classified by Balāl Sen, Rāja of Bengal, in the twelfth
century, (common names of the latter families are
Mukharji, Banarji, Chatoji, &c.); a worshipper of
Śakti according to the left-hand ritual; (आ), f. a
variety of the Āryā metre; (अम्), n. a disease of
the nails.
—कुलीन-ता, f. or कुलीन-त्व, अम्, n.
birth, rank, family respectability.

कुलीनक, अस्, आ, अम्, of good family; (अस्), m.
a kind of wild kidney-bean.

कुलेय, अस्, आ, अम् (at the end of compounds) =
कुलीन.

1. कुल्य, अस्, आ, अम्, of or relating to a family or
race; belonging to a congregation or corporation; of
good family, well-born, well-descended; (अस्), m. a
respectable man; (आ), f. a virtuous or decent woman;
custom or habit of a family?; (अम्), n. friendly in-
quiry after family affairs or domestic accidents, con-
dolence, congratulation, &c. (For 2. 3. see col. 3.)

कुल्य 2. कुल्य, अम्, n. (for 1. कुल्य see
col. 1), a bone; flesh; a winnowing basket; a
measure of eight Droṇas.
3. कुल्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. belonging to a river.

कुल्या 1. कुल्या, f., Ved. a small river; a
river in general; a canal, a channel for irrigation; a
ditch, a dyke or trench; N. of a river.

कूल्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. belonging to a bank or
shore.

कुलङ्गी कुलङ्गी, f. a thorny plant; (a wrong
form for कुलिङ्गी.)

कुलञ्ज कुलञ्ज or कुलञ्जन, अस्, m. the
plant Alpinia Galanga, = गन्ध-मूल.

कुलट कुलट, अस्, m. (fr. कुल and rt. अट्?),
any son except one's own offspring, an adopted son,
a bought son, &c.; (आ), f. an unchaste woman.
—कुलटा-पति, इस्, m. the husband of an unchaste
woman, a cuckold.
कुलाट कुलाट, अस्, m. a kind of small fish.
कुलटी कुलटी, f. red arsenic, = कुनटी.
कुलति कुलति, अयस्, m. pl., N. of a people.

कुलत्थ कुलत्थ, अस्, m. (fr. कुल? cf. अश्-
वत्थ and कपित्थ), a kind of pulse, Dolichos
Uniflorus; (आस्), m. pl., N. of a people; (आ), f. a kind
of Dolichos; a blue stone used in medicine and ap-
plied as a collyrium to the eyes, also as an astringent
to sores &c.; a species of metre.

कुलत्थिका, f. a blue stone used as a collyrium
&c.; a sort of vetch, considered as a wild sort of the
Dolichos Uniflorus.

कुलभ कुलभ, अस्, m., N. of a Daitya;
(another reading has सुलभ.)

कुलहण्डक कुलहण्डक, अस्, m. an eddy,
= कूलहण्डक.
कुलाक्षुता कुलाक्षुता, f. a bitch.

कुलाद्य कुलाद्य, अस्, m. (?), N. of a country
or people.
कुलाभि कुलाभि, इस्, m. a treasure.

कुलाय कुलाय, अस्, अम्, m. n. (fr. कुल?), a
woven texture, a web; the nest of a bird; a case or
investing integument, a receptacle; the body as the
dwelling-place of the soul; the kennel or resting-place
of a dog &c.; a place, a spot in general.
—कुलाय-
निलाय, अस्, m. the act of sitting in a nest, hatching,
brooding.
—कुलायनिलायि-ता, f. the act or state of
hatching, &c.
—कुलाय-निलायिन्, ई, इनी, इ, sitting in
a nest, brooding, hatching.
—कुलाय-स्थ, अस्, m.
‘nest-dweller,’ a bird.

कुलाययत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत् (fr. nom. कुलायय), Ved.
building nests or a resting-place, hiding one's self in
a nest.
कुलायिका, f. a bird-cage, an aviary.

कुलायिन्, ई, इनी, इ, Ved. forming a nest, shaped like
a nest, homely; (इनी), f., N. of a liturgical service.

कुलाल कुलाल, अस्, m. (said to be fr. rt.
कुल्), a potter; a wild cock, Phasianus Gallus; an
owl; (ई), f. the wife of a potter; N. of a plant; a
species of blue stone applied as a collyrium to the
eyes (कुलत्थिका).
—कुलाल-वत्, ind. like a potter.

कुलालिका कुलालिका, f. an aviary; (a wrong
form for कुलायिका.)

कुलाह कुलाह, अस्, m. a horse of a light-
brown colour with black knees.

कुलाहक कुलाहक, अस्, m. a lizard, a chame-
lion; N. of a plant, commonly Rāṅgā Kulekhāḍā.

कुलाहल कुलाहल, अस्, m., N. of a plant,
= अलम्बुष, गोच्छाल, भूकदम्ब, commonly
Kokaśimā, Coryza Terebinthina or Celsia Coroman-
delina, (a plant which dogs are fond of smelling before
they eject urine.)

कुलि कुलि, इस्, m. the hand; (इस्), f., N. of
a plant, = कण्टकारी, a prickly nightshade.

कुली कुली, f. a wife's elder sister; the
plant Solanum Jacquini or Solanum Longum (वृ-
हती).

कुलिङ्ग कु-लिङ्ग, अस्, m. (see 1. कु), a kind
of mouse; a species of bird, the fork-tailed shrike;
N. of a man; (आ), f., N. of a town; (ई), f., N. of a
plant [cf. कर्कट-शृङ्गी]; the female of the fork-
tailed shrike.
—कुलिङ्गाक्षी (˚ग-अक्˚), f., N. of a
plant, = पेटिका, कुवेराक्षी.
कुलिङ्गक, अस्, m. a sparrow.

कुलिज कुलिज, अस् or अम् (?), m. or n. (?),
a sort of measure (occurring at the end of com-
pounds in the forms कुलिज, अस्, ई, अम्; कुलिजिक, अस्,
ई, अम्; कुलिजीन, अस्, आ, अम्).

कुलिन्द कुलिन्द, आस्, m. pl., N. of a people;
(अस्), m. sing. the prince of this people.

कुलिर कुलिर, अस्, m. a crab; also कुलीर,
q. v.

कुलीर कुलीर, अस्, अम्, m. n. (said to be fr.
1. कृ), a crab; the sign of the zodiac Cancer; [cf.
कुलिर.]
—कुलीर-शृङ्गी, f., N. of a plant; [cf.
कर्कट-शृङ्गी.]
—कुलीराद् (˚र-अद्), त्, m. a young
crab (destroying its parents; the old crab being sup-
posed to perish on producing young).

कुलिश कुलिश, अस्, अम्, m. n. (fr. 1. कु and
लिश, = रिश fr. रिश्), Ved. an axe, a hatchet; the
thunderbolt of Indra; a sort of fish; the plant Helio-
tropium Indicum; (ई), f., Ved., N. of a river supposed
to be in the middle region of the sky.
—कुलिश-
नायक, अस्, m. a kind of coitus.
—कुलिश-भृत्, त्,
m. a N. of Indra, the bearer of the thunderbolt.
—कुलिशाङ्कुशा (˚श-अङ्˚), f., N. of one of the
sixteen Vidyā-devīs.

कुलीश कुलीश, अस्, अम्, m. n. Indra's thun-
derbolt; [cf. कुलिश.]

कुलिशासन कुलि-शासन, अस्, m. (fr. कुलिन्
and शासन? or fr. कुलि and शासन, ‘one who
commands with his hand?’), an epithet of Śākya-
muni.
कुलीनस कुलीनस, अम्, n. water.

कुलीपय कुलीपय, अस्, m., Ved. an aquatic
animal.
कुलीरक, अस्, m. a small crab.

कुलुक कुलुक, अम्, n. the fur or foulness
of the tongue.

कुल्लूक कुल्लूक or कुल्लूक-भट्ट, अस्, m., N.
of a celebrated scholiast on Manu.

कुलुक्कगुञ्जा कुलुक्क-गुञ्जा, f. a firebrand;
(for उल्का-गुञ्जा?).
कुलुङ्ग कुलुङ्ग, अस्, m., Ved. an antelope.

कुलुञ्च कु-लुञ्च, अस्, m. (see 1. कु), Ved.
one who plucks out hairs.
कुलूत कुलूत, आस्, m. pl., N. of a people.

कुल्फ कुल्फ, अस्, m. (said to be fr. 3. कल्),
Ved. the ancle; (अस्, अम्), m. n. a disease.

कुल्मल कुल्मल, अम्, n. (said to be fr. rt.
कुष्), Ved. the part of an arrow or spear by which
the head is attached to the shaft; sin.
—कुल्मल-
बर्हिष, अस्, m., N. of a Vedic poet.

कुल्माष कुल्माष, अस् or अम्, m. or n. sour
gruel prepared by the spontaneous fermentation of
the juice of fruits or of boiled rice; (अम्), n. half-
ripe barley; forced rice; a sort of Phaseolus, see
राज-माष; a species of Dolichos, D. Biflorus, see
यावक; (अस्), m. a kind of disease; (ई), f., N. of a
river.
—कुल्माषाभिषुत (˚ष-अभ्˚), अम्, n.
sour gruel.
कुल्मास = कुल्माष.

कुल्याय, nom. A. कुल्यायते, -यितुम्, to become
a river.

कुल्व कुल्व, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. bald, bare
[Lat. calvus] in अति-कुल्व, too bald.

कुल्वक कुल्वक, अम्, n. fur upon the tongue;
[cf. कुवुक.]

कुल-धर्म; add — the observances of the
Kaulas.
कुल-मार्ग; add — the doctrine of the Kaulas.
कुल-वर्त्मन्, अ, n. the doctrine of the Kaulas.
